 Strong strategic thinking and the ability to translate vision into actionable plans.

Du willst nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern Verantwortung dafür übernehmen, dass aus einer Produktidee ein belastbares Softwareprodukt wird?
Als Lead Product Engineer bist du ein zentraler Teil von MEONDI Frontier Services und gestaltest mit uns, wie wir neue Produkte technisch denken und umsetzen. Du bringst die technische Perspektive von Anfang an in wichtige Entscheidungen ein und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Konsequenzen dieser Entscheidungen.

jobs.title: Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Agora Industry Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you!
Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries.  Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a
 
 Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d) 
Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin 
 
You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams.

 Your responsibilities include Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR).
 Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. 
 Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms
 Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks.  
 Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. 
 Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors.
 Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe. 
 Liaising with expert colleagues across the Agora Think Tanks (including Agora Agriculture) to facilitate their contributions to projects and knowledge sharing across different regions.
 Actively contributing to internal discussions.
 Managing subcontractors including preparing agreements and work plans, supervising and guiding project progress, and managing the quality of deliverables.
 As Project Officer,  the focus is on contributing to the technical management of specific projects with smaller budget, largely independent research, contributing to the conceptualisation and development of complex topics, and of project-related reporting and communication. 
 As Project Manager , the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication.
 

 We are looking for A Master’s degree in energy, environmental engineering or forestry/agriculture engineering, natural sciences, renewable energies, agricultural economist, or similar 
 As Project Officer : Preferably 2 years of experience (including internships, student work or post-graduate roles) in the field of quantitative analysis of biomass systems.
 As Project Manager : At least 4 years of overall professional experience, with 2 years

Build something monumental for Healthcare!

 
 At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
 We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
 
 About the Role 
 You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped.

At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our France office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners.

You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind.
 
This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem.
 
 What You'll Do 
 Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations.

 Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners.

 Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in France and the integrations team in Stockholm.

 Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.

 Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform.

 Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity.

 Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery.

 Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly.

 Support our sales organisation in answering technical questions from our customers.
  

 What You Bring 
 Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment.

 Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders.

 Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers.

 Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum.

 Ability to anticipate, assess, and manage risk in projects, from scoping through to delivery.

 Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction.

 A product mindset - you care about building the right thing, not just delivering on time.

 Native level english speaking.

 Bonus Points

 Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments

 Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards

 Experience working with platform or API products

jobs.title: Operations Manager, Product & Engineering
jobs.description:
About us 
 Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.
 We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.
 Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor . Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.
 What you’ll do 
 Run the operating cadence for Product & Engineering: own planning cycles, roadmap workflows, initiative tracking, sprint planning, and team initiatives

 Design and optimize key processes like product reviews, retrospectives, team syncs, and engineering demos to drive clarity and velocity

 Build and maintain operational artifacts such as roadmaps, planning docs, capacity trackers, dashboards, and retros that keep everyone informed and aligned

 Coordinate cross-functional initiatives that span Product, Eng, Design, Brand, Sales, and Ops teams—driving alignment, timelines, and accountability

 Partner with product, eng and marketing leads to create scalable frameworks for goal-setting (e.g., OKRs), prioritization, and execution

 Analyze operational data and team feedback to identify friction points and implement systems that improve execution and outcomes

 Build our internationalization operations playbook and continuously improve it so we can scale with quality and intention

 What you’ll bring 
 6-8+ years of experience in Product Operations, Business Operations, or Program Management in a high-growth, product-led company

 Proven track record building and scaling operational processes from scratch

 Highly organized and methodical; you bring rigor, structure, and momentum to ambiguous situations

 Excellent written and verbal communicator—clear, succinct, and persuasive across stakeholders and levels

 Comfortable using tools like Linear, Figma, Google Drive, or similar to create systems that stick

 Strong analytical instincts with proficiency in Excel/Sheets; SQL or dashboard experience is a plus

 Even better… 
 Experience at an early-stage startup or scaling product org

 Familiarity with OKR frameworks, roadmap tools, or product analytics platforms

 Background in product management, engineering, or consulting/strategy with deep operational exposure

 Experience with vendor management and localization expansion efforts

 Our values 
 Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

 What we offer 
 We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:
 Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 Life insurance and disability benefits

 Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 Parental leave

 Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Software
jobs.description:
Cambridge, UK | Full-time | Permanent | Hybrid 

Salary: £75,000 to £95,000, DOE  

 

About us 

Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress. From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges. But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved.  Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology. QEC is a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion.  

Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our cutting-edge R&D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and government agencies to make fault-tolerant quantum computing a reality. We’re making remarkable progress and growing fast.  

 

About the role 

We are looking for an exceptional Senior Product Manager with a background in science or engineering and quantum computing or HPC experience to help define and grow an important part of Riverlane’s software product portfolio.

This is an early-stage, fast-moving area of our product roadmap: you’ll help shape its direction as much as run what already exists.

You’ll sit right at the heart of this product area, working closely with users, partners and cross-functional teams to deeply understand real-world challenges and translate them into a compelling product direction. You’ll use a blend of user insight, product data and market context to cut through complexity and focus on what matters most.

You’ll own and evolve the strategy and roadmap, bringing together engineering, research, business development and marketing around a shared vision, striking the balance between bold, long-term ambition and what’s realistically achievable today.

This role sits close to the centre of Riverlane, working daily with colleagues across Engineering, Science and the PMO. We ask for three days a week in our Cambridge office to make that collaboration easy.

This role involves quarterly travel, less than 10% of your time, to conferences such as IEEE and to visit customers.

 

What you will do

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for your product area, balancing user needs, stakeholder input and Riverlane’s strategic direction
  • Engage with customers, partners and internal teams to build a complete picture of market needs and the competitive landscape
  • Use product usage data, market insight and competitive analysis to prioritise features and drive adoption
  • Align stakeholders across the C-suite, research, engineering, business development and marketing, and identify new market opportunities for Riverlane
  • Support go-to-market execution and launch readiness with Marketing and Business Development, including external collateral and documentation
  • Monitor delivery progress and adapt plans as new challenges or opportunities emerge

 

What we need

  • A background in engineering or science (degree or equivalent experience)
  • 4+ years in B2B product management
  • Experience in a HPC or quantum computing, translating complex technical trade-offs into product decisions
  • High emotional intelligence, with strong active listening and critical thinking skills
  • A collaborative, cross-functional team player who can influence without authority and build trust across teams
  • Ease with going technically deep, both internally and externally, to understand product capabilities and limitations
  • Someone who thrives in a fast-moving, ambiguous and rapidly evolving environment

jobs.title: Product Manager, Finance Engineering
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us to redefine the future of on-demand delivery. To do this, we're building a world-class Finance Engineering (FinEng) organization across all global markets we support at DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. in which each of our product managers plays a critical role in helping to define and execute our vision to move money accurately and at scale across every market we operate in and ensure finance and accounting compliance. As we grow, billions of dollars in money movements flow through our platform every year and our team makes sure every one of them is understood, trusted, and correctly reflected in the financial books.

About the Role

Product Managers on the Finance Engineering team need a systems-oriented mindset, platform thinking, and strong cross-functional collaboration. In this role, you will define the strategy and vision for systems that track billions of dollars in company-wide money movement, translate transactions into accounting entries, and accelerate the financial close. You will build scalable, audit-ready automation for complex, high-volume financial activity.

This is an opportunity to reshape modern accounting by applying AI to reconciliation, investigations, and incident detection and mitigation. Your products will form a critical part of the company’s financial infrastructure and help earn the confidence of leadership, auditors, and regulators.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Drive the product definition, strategy, and long-term vision for accounting automation. You own the roadmap
  • Build systems that track billion-dollar-level money movements across the entire company and automatically convert them into accurate accounting entries
  • Reinvent and accelerate the accounting close process, reducing manual effort and shortening close timelines
  • Champion AI-driven approaches to transform close reconciliation, financial investigations, and incident detection and mitigation
  • Partner with FinEng, Accounting, and Finance leaders to translate complex financial and regulatory requirements into scalable, automated products
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, data scientists, accountants, and operators
  • Communicate product plans, benefits, and results to key stakeholders including the leadership team

We're excited about you because…

  • You have a track record in product management, including driving product strategy, vision, and roadmap alignment
  • You have built complex, back-end, data-intensive, or platform products. Ideally in fintech, payments, accounting, or financial systems
  • You have a strong grasp of accounting concepts (e.g. double-entry, ledgers, reconciliations, the close process) and how financial data flows through complex system
  • You do your best work with range: global platform thinking alongside the accounting reality of a specific brand or market
  • You're an execution power-house who thrives in ambiguity and operates at the lowest level of detai

jobs.title: Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus 
 Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche. 
 Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt. 

 Deine Rolle bei June 
 
 Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO. 
 Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche.  
 Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen. 

 Anforderungen Was du mitbringst 
 Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten. 

 Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich)  

 Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools. 

 Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs). 

 AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst. 

 Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch. 

 Das wäre ein Plus 
 Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel.  

 Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung. 

 

 Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst 
 Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience. 

 Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort. 

 Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst. 

 Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen. 

 Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich. 

 Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team. 

 Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June. 

 So arbeiten wir 
 
 Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs. 
 Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern. 
 Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht. 
 Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release. 

 Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet 
 Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen. 

 Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern 

 Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite. 

 Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap. 

 Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege. 

 Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess. 

 Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten. 

 Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort. 

 Hinweis:  Die Stelle wird zunächst über Bridgemaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt.

jobs.description:
About BlaBlaCar 

 BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely. 
 

 The role 

 Carpool Experience covers everything between two members once they have found each other: agreeing on the trip, talking, meeting up, and building trust.

 Vision: a carpool experience that feels easy and safe for passengers and drivers, from the first hello to the final goodbye.

 Mission: make it simple for members to talk, negotiate, meet up and trust each other.

 You own six product areas, used by millions of members every month:

 Messaging. The chat between drivers and passengers. Next up: Group Chat, and catching up with market standards.

 
 GPS Tracking: both the technical capability as well as features it enables (including sharing ETA on the map, ESC bonus in Spain among others)

 
 Post-Carpool ride XP (claims, ratings etc.). How members build trust in each other. This includes AI Ratings Summary, BlaBlaCar's first consumer-facing GenAI feature.

 Shape the future of Negotiation. Work out where its real value is for members and for BlaBlaCar, decide how it should evolve (new use cases such as negotiation after booking, conversion, usage), and prove the impact on passengers (PAX) and GMV.

 Ship the next member interactions: Group Chat, live location for both drivers and passengers, and the next version of the Communication Service.

jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. 
 n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.
 
 Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:
 
 Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

 
That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register .
 
 We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.
 We're looking for an experienced design manager to lead our Product Design team.
 This is a management role. Your job is to develop designers, raise the quality of the work, and make sure design has real influence on where the product goes. It is not a player-coach role, and it is not a step up for a strong IC looking for their first management position. We need someone who has already managed product designers and can do it well from day one.
 n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems your team tackles are complex. Design decisions have to account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes ripple across the whole platform. You'll need enough craft depth to recognise excellent work, challenge it constructively, and help designers get better. The team needs a manager whose design judgment they trust.
 You'll manage a team spanning product designers, design engineers and user researchers at a range of seniority levels, working across our product areas. You'll work alongside our other design manager. You'll report to our VP of Product until our Head of Design joins the team. That search is running now.
 More than 80% of workflows built on n8n involve AI agents, and we're widening from a developer audience to a broader set of builders. That shift is the central design problem here, and your team is at the centre of it.
 🎯 Your main goal is to build a Product Design team that consistently produces excellent work and shapes how n8n's product evolves. Here's what that involves:
 
Lead and develop the team
 Run regular, high-quality 1:1s and coach designers, design engineers and researchers across different levels.

 Own performance management: evidence-based reviews, honest feedback, and real support for anyone who isn't where they need to be.

 Help people understand what's expected at their level and what growth looks like, evolving our progression framework for Product Design.

 Hire excellent designers as the team grows, and broaden the range of backgrounds and perspectives on the team.

 Raise the design bar
 Set and hold a high standard across problem framing, user understanding, interaction design, information architecture and visual craft.

 Facilitate design critiques and reviews that measurably improve the work, and help designers think beyond the feature in front of them.

 Develop designers' judgment and autonomy rather than becoming the final approval layer for every decision.

 Own the whole product experience
 Keep a holistic view across features and product areas, identifying inconsistencies, recurring UX problems, and opportunities for more coherent patterns.

 Work with the team to address fragmentation systematically rather than feature by feature.

 Make design a real partner
 Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership so design contributes early to problem definition and product direction, not late to execution.

 Help designers influence product decisions through strong reasoning rather than positional authority.

 Improve how the team works across critique, collaboration, decision-making and knowledge sharing, introducing structure where it helps the team scale and resisting process that slows things down.

You’ll partner closely with Engineering and teams across Product, Marketing, Ops, Design, Analytics, and Legal and Compliance to set product direction and turn it into capabilities teams can successfully adopt. You’ll navigate complex technical and business tradeoffs, balance near-term needs with longer-term platform investments, and help determine where Affirm should build capabilities directly versus work with third-party partners.

 

What you'll do 

  • Set product strategy and roadmap for Comms Plat, connecting customer needs, business priorities, and technical opportunities.

  • Lead complex platform initiatives from strategy through launch and adoption, working closely with Engineering and cross-functional partners.

  • Build strong relationships across Affirm so communications needs for new products, markets, and customer journeys are understood early and reflected in platform plans.

  • Shape channel, platform, and partner strategy, including thoughtful build-versus-buy decisions across the communications ecosystem.

  • Make clear tradeoffs across customer experience, reliability, scalability, cost, regulatory requirements, and speed.

  • Define meaningful measures of success and use customer, product, operational, and business signals to guide priorities and investment.

 

What we look for

  • 8+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience, with a track record of leading complex products or platforms.

 CreatorIQ is the software enterprise brands and agencies use to run their creator marketing programs. Customers include Burson, Delta Air Lines, Google, LVMH, Nestlé and Sephora. Those programs only hold up if the content is brand safe, sponsorships are disclosed, the music is cleared, and every campaign follows the rules in the markets it runs in. You'll own the product that makes that happen.
 The core is SafeIQ, our always-on brand safety system. It runs multimodal AI classification on audio, video, images and text across millions of creator posts, and flags risk before it becomes a headline.
 If you like turning messy classification and regulatory problems into workflows that risk, legal and compliance teams trust, you'll fit in. We're growing fast, and we work with teams around the world who care about doing great work.

 Own the in-app brand safety review and workflow experience end to end, with one goal: shorten the path from "AI flagged something" to "a human made a confident decision." Ship, measure, learn, repeat.

 Decide how AI classification reaches people: severity, categories, thresholds, review states and false-positive handling. Work with data science on what the models look for across audio, video, images and text, how confident they need to be before surfacing something, and where a human stays in the loop. Make every flag explainable and auditable.

 Own compliance beyond content risk: sponsorship and ad disclosure under FTC guidelines and their equivalents, music licensing and rights clearance, legal drinking age (LDA) rules for alcohol promotion, and GDPR and regional privacy requirements. jobs.title: Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Description We are seeking a product manager to own the "what" and "why" of our quantum sensing measurement systems. You turn customer and market needs into clear product requirements that engineering can turn into specifications, and you own the roadmap for the QDm product line, starting with QDm.1. You sit between our customers (foundries, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs) and every engineering discipline, and you make sure we build the right product in the right order. 

 Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

 Why join us? Picture this: 
 Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.
 Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.
 Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.
 An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.
 Still unsure about why joining us? 
 You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.
 From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.
 Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.
 You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.
 Let’s make the invisible visible! 

 What will you do Own the product requirements: gather needs from customers, the field, the market, and internal stakeholders (serviceability, modularity and product configuration, manufacturability, and cost targets), and turn them into clear, prioritized, solution-neutral requirements.
 Establish our requirements engineering tooling and workflow: select and set up how we capture, trace, and maintain requirements, from customer need through specification to verification, including change control across releases. This is a foundational task in your first months.
 Own and maintain the QDm.1 roadmap: propose what gets built and in what order, make the trade-offs explicit, and align decisions with the management team.
 Work with the applications team on customer interactions and evaluations with fabs, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs, and translate what you learn into requirements.
 For each requirement, define acceptance criteria from the customer's point of view so it is clear and testable when the need is met, and link them to customer evaluation and qualification plans.
 Align with the Product Development department on scope and timing, and hand solution-neutral requirements into engineering: state the need and the why, and leave the how to the disciplines.
 Support go-to-market: give input on positioning, pricing, launch readiness, and documentation scope together with the applications, operations, and product development teams.
 

 What is expected of you Several years in product management for complex hardware or capital equipment, ideally in semiconductor, metrology, or a comparable deep-tech environment.
 A track record of writing clear product requirements that engineering can actually build from.
 The ability to talk to both customers and engineers and to translate between them.
 Enough technical depth to hold a credible conversation with the people designing the product, across mechanics, optics, electronics/RF, and software.
 Structured prioritization: you make trade-offs explicit and back them with reasoning.
 We hire for demonstrated skill rather than a specific degree; a technical or scientific background is typical. The working language is English.
 Additional experience we value: 
 Semiconductor industry knowledge (fabs, IDMs, OSATs, inspection, metrology, or failure analysis).
 Familiarity with SEMI standards and fab tool integration (for example, S2/S8, E10, SECS/GEM).
 Experience selecting or setting up a requirements management tool (for example, Jama, Polarion, or CodeBeamer).
 A working understanding of quantum sensing, optics, or precision instrumentation.

jobs.title: Product Owner (m/w/d) - Customer Domain
jobs.description:
Über uns Seit 2008 arbeiten wir mit unseren vier Marken doctari, lichtfeld, Planerio und arztpool an unserer Vision, medizinisches Personal dorthin zu bringen, wo es am dringendsten benötigt wird. 
 doctari pro ist unsere B2B-Buchungsplattform für Personalverantwortliche in Krankenhäusern und Gesundheitseinrichtungen und die zentrale Schnittstelle zur Demand-Seite unseres Marktplatzes. Über doctari pro können Ärztinnen und Ärzte unkompliziert gefunden, angefragt und gebucht werden: in Arbeitnehmerüberlassung oder befristeter Anstellung. Als Gegenstück zur doctari App auf der Kandidatenseite ist doctari pro ein zentraler Bestandteil unseres zweiseitigen Marktplatzes. 

 Deine neue Rolle Als Product Owner (m/w/d) im Customer Domain Team übernimmst du Verantwortung für einen der wichtigsten Wachstumshebel unseres Unternehmens. Gemeinsam mit deinem cross-funktionalen Team gestaltest du die Produktstrategie ebenso aktiv mit wie die Umsetzung neuer Features und bringst moderne Technologien wie KI gezielt in die Weiterentwicklung von doctari pro ein. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Engineering, UX Design und internen Stakeholdern zusammen und triffst fundierte Produktentscheidungen auf Basis von Nutzerdaten, technischen Anforderungen und Marktanforderungen. 
 
 Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung von doctari pro und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem cross-funktionalen Team innovative Features für Kliniken und Gesundheitseinrichtungen, von der Anfrage bis zur Buchung.

 Du priorisierst das Product Backlog anhand von Kundenbedürfnissen, Marktanforderungen und relevanten Produkt-KPIs.

 Du steuerst den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess von der Product Discovery über Delivery bis zum erfolgreichen Release.

 Du arbeitest mit internen Stakeholdern zusammen und übersetzt Marktanforderungen in klare Produktentscheidungen.

 Du analysierst Nutzungs- und Buchungsdaten, leitest Handlungsempfehlungen ab und optimierst kontinuierlich die Customer Journey auf doctari pro.

 Du treibst den gezielten Einsatz von Künstlicher Intelligenz im Produkt voran.

 

 Deine Erfahrung & Persönlichkeit Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle, idealerweise in einem B2B-SaaS-, Plattform- oder Marketplace-Umfeld.

 Erfahrung in der Entwicklung digitaler Produkte für Geschäftskunden: von der Product Discovery über nutzerzentriertes Design bis zur datengetriebenen Optimierung.

 Technisches Verständnis, das tief genug geht, um Architekturentscheidungen zu verstehen, Trade-offs zu bewerten und mit Engineering auf Augenhöhe zu diskutieren.

 Analytisches Denken, Pragmatismus sowie eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.
 Begeisterung für KI-gestützte Produkte und moderne Technologien, die du aktiv nutzt, um Produktmehrwert zu schaffen.

 Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Account Management oder Customer Success ist ein klares Plus.

 Sehr gute Deutsch- und fließende Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab.

jobs.description:
About Qorelo
 Almost every large company in the DACH region is facing the same task: the transformation to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point — nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.
 That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI layer for S/4HANA transformation: we read code, processes and documentation, make the existing landscape transparent, and deliver the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards — including in day-to-day operations, long after the system integrators have moved on.
 We've raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz.
 
 The role
 You'll be the person who decides what we build next, and why. You'll lead our two solution architects — the people who carry our SAP domain depth — and turn what they know about real transformation projects into a roadmap our engineers can ship. You'll work in close collaboration with our Head of Product Design and the engineering team, and you'll spend real time with the people who use the product: consultants, IT leads, and transformation teams inside enterprise clients.
 This is an early-stage PM role in the full sense: strategy and backlog, customer discovery and acceptance criteria, the big roadmap call and the unglamorous ticket. You'll do IC work alongside the thinking, and your decisions will show up in the product within weeks, running inside some of the largest SAP landscapes in Europe.
 
 What you'll own
 The product roadmap. You prioritize what our AI agents learn to do next across the transformation lifecycle — from fit-to-standard analysis to post-go-live evolution — and you can defend every call with customer evidence.

 The solution architects. You lead our two SAs directly, turning their module knowledge and project scar tissue into product requirements engineering can build against.

 Discovery with real users. Consultants and enterprise IT teams use Qorelo inside live transformation programmes. You sit with them, watch where the product wins and where it fails, and bring that back as decisions, not just notes.

 The bridge between domain and build. SAP depth on one side, an AI-native engineering team on the other. You speak enough of both languages that nothing gets lost in translation — and you work with our Head of Product Design so what we ship is usable by SAP people, not just correct.

 Shipping. Specs, acceptance criteria, tradeoffs, cut lines. Features reach real users on real landscapes, and you own whether they landed.
 

 What you need
 4+ years hands-on SAP experience, functional or product side — S/4HANA transformation, fit-to-standard, and module-level depth in at least one core area like FI, SD, or PP

 2+ years product experience: you've owned a roadmap, prioritized with engineering, and shipped features to real users — title doesn't matter, ownership does

 Strong AI curiosity — you've actually built or worked with LLM/agentic tooling, not just read about it

 Comfort in an early-stage environment: ambiguity, speed, IC work alongside strategy

 You want your product decisions to run inside DAX 40 landscapes within weeks, not sit in a committee for quarters

 Real ownership. Meaningful equity and a direct hand in the company's direction, not just your backlog. We're looking for people who want to shape a company, not join one.

 Competitive salary , benchmarked for senior product talent in Berlin.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager - France
jobs.description:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

 
 At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
 We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
 
 About the Role 
 You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped.

At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our France office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners.

You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind.
 
This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem.
 
 What You'll Do 
 Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations.

 Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners.

 Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in France and the integrations team in Stockholm.

 Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.

 Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform.

 Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity.

 Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery.

 Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly.

 Support our sales organisation in answering technical questions from our customers.
 

 What You Bring 
 Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment.

 Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders.

 Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers.

 Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum.

 Ability to anticipate, assess, and manage risk in projects, from scoping through to delivery.

 Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction.

 A product mindset - you care about building the right thing, not just delivering on time.

 Native level french speaking.

 Bonus Points 
 Experience in tech sales, enterprise sales, or enterprise software delivery

 Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments

 Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards

 Experience working with platform or API products

 Some hands-on technical experience (e.g. scripting, debugging, light coding)

 Experience scaling integration processes or working with multiple external partners

 
 Location 
 We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based in our Paris office, where you will work primarily on-site with the local team, while collaborating closely with colleagues at our HQ in Stockholm.
 
 How to Apply 
 We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:
 Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

 Technical interview with some of our Engineering team

 Follow-up interview with one of our Team Leads

 Home case and presentation at our Paris office - Join us for a lunch, a discovery meeting and a presentation to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate

In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams.  We look for You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO.

🏨 The Company
 Resilience Care is a leading medical remote monitoring player and a clinical research partner. Founded in France in 2021, our mission is simple: improve patient care.
We build remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology and psychiatry, powered by ePRO collection and AI techniques. Our platform helps care teams detect side effects early for continuous and proactive care, while our patient app helps people track and manage symptoms with tailored resources.
Our solutions optimize care pathways, enrich continuous patient understanding, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring and detailed analysis of real-world data.  Collaborate with Medical on clinical validation and with QARA on quality and compliance.

 Measure adoption and impact after delivery.

 Keep Product documentation, the semantic library and required QMS evidence current.
 

 ✨ Your Team
 You will join a Product team with complementary backgrounds, working closely with Medical and Tech as one R&D organisation. The team operates across therapeutic areas: mandates evolve with priorities, and each Product Manager remains accountable for the outcome of their initiatives.
 The role is fully remote, like the rest of the team, with an opportunity to meet in person during the annual company offsite.

 The ability to make trade-offs and their consequences visible.

 High standards for quality, documentation and measurement.

 📃 You are the right person if you have already 
 Built at least seven years of Product Management experience.

 Owned complex initiatives from discovery through impact measurement.

 Worked with multidisciplinary teams in healthcare or across healthcare systems.

 Used English fluently in a professional setting.

 Work on products connecting care-team needs, patient experience and technology.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
jobs.description:
Description Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes. 
 You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind. 

 Your mission 1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence  
 Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution. 

 Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy. 

 Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters. 

 Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo. 

 2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership  
 Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer. 

 Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders). 

 Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice. 

 Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos. 

 3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement  
 Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
 Â 
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
 Â 
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 
 The Role 
 KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
 Â 
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
 Â 
 The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
 Â 
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
 Â 
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
 Â 

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
 Â 

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
 Â 

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
 

 Location
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
 
 Language
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 
 Interview Process
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round
 

 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
jobs.description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey 
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.
 We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.
 The role 
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.
 This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.
 What you'll do 
 Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

 Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

 Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

 Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

 Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

 Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

 Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

 Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

 What we're looking for 
 Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

 Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

 AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

 High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

 Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

 Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

 Backgrounds that tend to fit 
 Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

 MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

 Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

 Why this is interesting 
 Competitive, top-of-market compensation

 You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

 Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

 Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

jobs.description:
About MoonPay

 MoonPay is for builders with something to prove.

 This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia.

 AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

 You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

 The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents. 

 Recent recognition:
 

 
 Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 . 
2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100 
 The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running

 About the Opportunity 

 
 
 In this role, you will own the roadmap for the systems that establish and verify who a MoonPay customer is, from sign-in through KYC clearance. This spans authentication (sign-in, MFA, session security), identity verification (KYC tiers, risk scoring, sanctions screening), and document verification, the vendor-driven flows that sit inside the KYC funnel.

 
 You will sit within the Identity team and work closely with Compliance, Risk/Fraud, Legal, and Engineering, as well as the third-party identity verification vendors MoonPay relies on.

 
 Your work will directly impact onboarding conversion, fraud loss, and MoonPay's ability to operate compliantly across multiple countries, balancing customer experience against risk and regulatory requirements on every decision.

 
 This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to own a product area where user experience, fraud risk, and hard regulatory constraints all collide, and who's motivated by getting that balance right rather than optimizing for just one of the three.

 
 What You Will Do 

 
 
 Own the roadmap for authentication and identity verification, prioritizing across conversion, fraud/risk reduction, and regulatory requirements.

 
 Drive improvements to onboarding funnels, reducing drop-off in document capture and verification while maintaining or improving fraud and conversion rates.

 
 Manage and evaluate third-party KYC/IDV vendor relationships, including performance, cost, and regional coverage.

 
 Partner with Compliance and Legal to translate regulatory requirements into product specs and rollout plans.

 
 Work with Engineering to ship changes to authentication flows without introducing account-takeover or fraud exposure.

 
 Define and track funnel metrics.

 
 Represent Identity in cross-functional planning with Risk, Fraud, Compliance, and Legal stakeholders.

 
 About You 

 Must-have experience and skills 

 
 
 4+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent on identity verification, KYC/AML, fraud, or authentication/security products.

 
 Working familiarity with KYC/AML concepts and authentication concepts.

 
 Experience managing or evaluating third-party identity/KYC vendors.

 
 Comfort operating in a regulated, multi-region environment where the same feature behaves differently by jurisdiction.

 
 Nice-to-have experience 

 
 
 Background in fintech, crypto, or another regulated marketplace.

 
 Experience with sanctions screening, PEP/adverse media checks, or transaction monitoring.

 
 Bonus Points 

 
 
 Experience with crypto-native authentication (wallet-based sign-in, sign-in with Ethereum) or crypto compliance requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Hardware & Edge AI (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
New Challenge About Us 
Project Q GmbH ("Q") is a defence technology company with offices in Berlin and Munich, and a trusted partner of the German Armed Forces. Our customers field sensors, drones and C2 systems from many vendors that were never built to work together. We build Hydris, an orchestration layer that integrates the systems they already field, and the ones they'll add next, into one picture operators can act on across defence, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Hydris runs at the edge, keeps working when the link drops, and its core is open source under Apache 2.0.

As Senior Product Manager for Mission Devices, you'll own the hardware that puts Hydris in the field. 

You'll work end-to-end, from discovery with operators through hardware build cycles to fielded units, and you'll decide what gets built rather than work through someone else's backlog. The bar is concrete: devices that run for months off-grid in contested RF environments.

What you'll do
 Discovery and requirements Spend time with end users in their operating environment to understand their workflows in depth, not just their stated requirements.
 Validate assumptions about value, usability, feasibility and viability through prototypes, bench tests and field trials before committing to hardware fabrication.
 Analyze contractual specifications with Program Managers, separating firm constraints from areas where there's room for the best technical solution.
 Roadmap and delivery Maintain an outcome-focused roadmap aligned to hardware build cycles (EVT/DVT/PVT), firmware releases and OTA update pipelines.
 Define requirements and field metrics for each device, including detection performance, energy efficiency, mission endurance and SWaP, and make the trade-offs between them.

jobs.description:
Who we are: 
 We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay.
 We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers.
  
 Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us?
 About The Role. 
 You will lead a team of ~3-4 product analysts for our Customer Growth and Lifecycle domain, owning narrative and insights and driving sustainable customer customer growth. You will be a thought partner with a Director of Product and you will influence roadmap and product decisions, and also work cross-functionally day-to-day with Marketing, Risk, Finance and the rest of Data.
 
The scope runs from acquisition source and sign-up, through credit approval, activation, repeat usage, arrears behaviour, retention, and cohort profitability. You'll need to be as comfortable talking about loss rates and payback periods as you are about conversion funnels and retention curves, and tie everything we’re doing to commercial outcomes.

You will be a hands-on leader solving some of the most complex customer and business problems, while also managing a team of ~3-4 product analysts. You will be someone who thrives at using complex data and intuition to drive business outcomes, ensuring data is a core driver of company strategy.
 
 What you’ll be doing day to day. 
 Own the analytics strategy for the Customer Lifecycle domain - from acquisition quality through activation, retention, and cohort profitability - translating the company-wide analytics vision into a focused plan for your team.

 Operate horizontally across Lifecycle squads: your analysts are already embedded, so your job is to connect the dots, spot patterns across teams, and ensure the collective effort ladders up to domain commercial goals.

 Know the key commercial drivers inside out - cohort payback, contribution margin, funnel economics, risk-adjusted value - so you can direct work with conviction and challenge outputs with authority.

 Build experimentation capability within the domain pragmatically - establish clear hypotheses, decision criteria, and honest readouts as the norm for your teams.

 Increase stakeholder self-sufficiency through dashboards and shared frameworks - freeing your analysts from reactive requests and shifting their time towards high-value proactive work.

 Grow and focus your team - coach analysts, raise the technical bar, and create clarity on what good looks like for the domain.

 Be the primary analytics partner for Lifecycle product leadership - earning trust by consistently surfacing what matters, not just what's been asked for.

 Raise the standard of evidence in domain product decisions - moving from opinion-led to evidence-led, one decision at a time.

  
 What We're Looking For. 
 Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and embrace change as an opportunity.

 6+ years in product analytics or insight-focussed roles (start-up or scale-up pace) and 2+ years leading a team of analysts.

 Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and present complex findings succinctly.

 You're comfortable with credit risk concepts: loss rates, approval rates, unit economics. You don't need to be a risk modeller, but you can't be allergic to the topic.

 Strong technical foundation in analytics with advanced SQL. You can model data, design experiments, and have a proper technical conversation if required

 Comfortable operating at both strategic and tactical levels, able to “zoom in” on critical insights while maintaining a holistic view.

 You've built experimentation programmes - not just run one-off tests, but established how a team thinks about evidence.

 You're opinionated about what matters, but you update your views when the data says otherwise.

 Experience in payments, regulated environments, or financial environments.
